sources.title: Early Fire Detection Design Model for Smart Cities: Using AWS IoT and ...
sources.snippet: Conclusion In this blog, we covered a reference architecture to design a scalable early fire detection system for smart cities. By leveraging AWS IoT, this solution supports ingesting data from thousands of sensors across the city for near real-time detection and alerts.

sources.title: Applications of AI - NFPA
sources.snippet: Evacuation and Crowd Control Existing novel methods for smart evacuation and crowd management could soon get a boost from faster AI programs. Dynamic exit signs direct occupants to the optimal and safest route of egress in the event of a fire or other emergency, depending on the specific conditions inside the building.
